parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description:
Configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global configurations or rule configurations. Valid values:
- global: Query global configurations.
- rule: Query rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If not specified, no distinction is made between global and rule configurations.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1-500.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. You can query the rule whose name matches the specified value.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID. You can obtain it by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) API.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: version 0.
